title: Gemini thought this was a sport.
caption:
Gemini thought the modes were a sport. Cardinal signs start, fixed signs hold, mutable signs adapt, and each season begins as the Sun enters a cardinal sign.
Start it, hold it, pass it on. Which one are you?
